# KREATO.AI — AI Agents for Polish SMB Companies

## About
KREATO.AI builds AI voice bots, chatbots and automation agents for Polish small and medium businesses. Main product: Karolina, an AI voice receptionist that answers phone calls 24/7 in Polish.

## Products
- **Karolina AI** — AI voice receptionist (Polish). Answers incoming calls 24/7, answers FAQ, books appointments in Google Calendar, sends SMS confirmations and notifies the owner (Telegram or e-mail). Handles several calls at the same time. It does not make outgoing calls to customers.
- **Chatbot AI** — website chatbot, from 199 PLN net/month; can check free slots and book visits.
- **Chatbot AI in Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp (pilot)** — the same assistant on messaging channels, 249 PLN net/month (207 per month on the annual plan, pay 10 months use 12). Pilot with the first clients: launch depends on Meta approvals and the client's business accounts; WhatsApp needs the client's own number not used in the regular WhatsApp app. Details: https://kreato.tech/#faq-kanaly
- **Bot dla sklepu (Shop Bot)** — chatbot for online stores: checks order status (order number plus e-mail or phone must match), accepts return and cancellation requests and forwards them to the shop (the shop decides), answers shipping, payment and complaint questions from the shop's knowledge base. WooCommerce via a read-only API key (pilot); Shoptet and Shopify in preparation. Start 299 PLN net/month (status and knowledge base), Pro 399 PLN net/month (adds returns and cancellations with Telegram notification); annual plan, pay 10 months use 12: 249 / 333 PLN. Page: https://kreato.tech/bot-dla-sklepu.html
- **Powrót uśpionych klientów SMS (Winback, pilot)** — SMS campaigns to former clients who gave marketing consent: client list import, preview and owner approval before anything is sent, weekdays 10:00-18:00 in small batches, STOP opt-out honored permanently, one SMS per number per 31 days, replies forwarded to the owner on Telegram. 199 PLN net/month with a limit of 200 SMS (165 PLN on the annual plan, pay 10 months use 12). The customer confirms they hold the consents; the bot does not hold conversations or book visits. See /bot-powrot-klientow-sms.html
- **Przypomnienia o płatnościach (invoice reminders, pilot)** — SMS reminders about invoice due dates: import of the invoice list (file or API; Fakturownia export format prepared), a ladder of reminders 3 days before, on the due date and 3, 7 and 14 days after, owner approval at the start, weekdays 9:00-18:00, one SMS per number per 2 days, STOP honored permanently, a reply like 'paid' pauses reminders and alerts the owner on Telegram, daily Telegram report. It is soft reminding, not debt collection; it does not decide whether an invoice is paid. Start 119 PLN net/month (up to 100 SMS) or Plus 159 PLN net/month (up to 300 SMS); annual plan 99 / 133 PLN per month (pay 10 months use 12); extra SMS 0.25 PLN by arrangement. SMS only for now (no e-mail), no automatic integration with invoicing programs yet.
- **Asystent dokumentów firmowych (company documents assistant, pilot)** — Employee assistant answering questions from the company's own documents (work rules, safety instructions, procedures, FAQ) in Telegram: answers only from the uploaded documents, names the source documents, says 'not found' instead of guessing, access groups per document enforced in the database before the AI model sees any fragment, one-time invitation codes for employees, history of questions to spot gaps. Text input only for now (PDF/Word converted before upload); question and selected fragments are processed by the AI model provider (OpenAI). Team 239 PLN net/month (5 employees, 50 documents, 1,000 questions) or Firma 359 PLN net/month (20 employees, 200 documents, 3,000 questions); annual plan 199 / 299 PLN per month (pay 10 months use 12); extra 1,000 questions 39 PLN by arrangement. Pilot.
- **Opinie w Google po wizycie (Google reviews by SMS, pilot)** — after a visit the client gets one SMS asking to rate it 1-5 by reply; every client, whatever the rating, is invited to review the business on Google (no review gating, no links in the SMS, no incentives); a low rating (1-3) triggers an alert to the owner on Telegram; STOP honored permanently, one request per number per 30 days. Start 99 PLN net/month (100 visits) or Plus 149 PLN (300 visits); annual plan 83 / 124 PLN per month (pay 10 months use 12). Details: https://kreato.tech/bot-opinie-google.html
- **Pakiet „Gabinet” (bundle, pilot)** — Our bots are meant to be ordered as a set, because revenue grows when a client goes through the whole path: caught by phone, booked, asked for a review, brought back. Package: Karolina AI Lite + Opinie w Google Start + Powrót uśpionych klientów in one price: 449 PLN net/month instead of 577 PLN separately (Lite 279 + Opinie 99 + Winback 199); annual plan, pay 10 months use 12: 374 PLN/month (4,490 PLN per year). Start with Karolina: 7 days for 0 PLN, no card, up to 100 minutes; add the other two later. Every client is invited to review on Google (no review gating), win-back SMS go out only after the owner approves and only to clients with marketing consent. Page: https://kreato.tech/pakiet-gabinet.html
- **Asystent biura AI (Telegram, pilot)** — an AI assistant for a small-business owner in Telegram: ask for a report on open and overdue invoices, prepare SMS payment reminders for debtors, add an invoice or mark it paid. Nothing is sent or changed until the owner replies YES (TAK); proposals expire after 15 minutes; the assistant identifies itself as AI, cannot pay, delete data or send anything except payment reminders. A chat is linked to a company with a one-time code (/start CODE). 199 PLN net/month, 600 assistant messages per month; annual plan 165 PLN/month (pay 10 months use 12, 1,990 PLN per year). Works on the invoice list of the payment-reminders bot (from 119 PLN net/month), combined price agreed in the pilot. Not yet: PDF invoices, accounting-software integrations, calling clients. Details: https://kreato.tech/bot-asystent-biura.html
- **Strona internetowa dla małej firmy (website, new, pilot)** — a simple one-page website for a local business. A draft is generated in a few minutes from public data only (name, industry, city, address, phone, Google Maps rating and number of reviews); the offer section is left for the owner to fill in; nothing is invented (no prices, opening hours, history, certificates or customer reviews); published only after the owner approves. From 599 PLN net, one-time (final price depends on scope and is given before work starts; the annual-plan discount does not apply to one-time fees). Monthly site care from 49 PLN net/month: hosting, SSL certificate, backups, uptime monitoring and up to one small content change per month; bigger changes, new subpages and a store are quoted separately; the domain is registered in the owner's name with a separate yearly registrar fee. The site is built to generate enquiries (call button, contact details, Google rating as social proof, space for the owner's services or products); a full online store with cart and payments is quoted separately. It is prepared to be found: title and description with name, industry and city, schema.org structured data (name, address, phone), sitemap and robots.txt, submission to Google and Bing, a short llms.txt with basic company data for AI assistants, and Open Graph tags for link previews on Facebook and Messenger; no guarantee of ranking or number of customers. It works best together with our bots: Karolina AI (from 249 PLN net/month on the annual plan) answers phone calls 24/7 and books visits; Chatbot AI (like Asia, the assistant on kreato.tech; from 199 PLN net/month, 159 with the Voicebot) answers visitor questions and collects contact details, also at night; Opinie w Google (from 99) and Powrót uśpionych klientów add reviews and returning customers; Pakiet „Gabinet” bundles three of them for 449 instead of 577 PLN (pilots, no promised results). Also optional: Reklama FB/IG (from 249 PLN net/month, ad budget separate). Page: https://kreato.tech/strona-internetowa.html · FAQ 52: https://kreato.tech/#faq-strona-internetowa
- **Reklama FB/IG** — Facebook and Instagram ad management, from 249 PLN net/month (ad budget separate).
- **SMM + Reels AI** — automated social media content (posts, graphics, Reels); you approve and publish them yourself; from 199 PLN net/month.
- **Raporty automatyczne** — automatic reports, from 149 PLN net/month.
- **Monitoring konkurencji AI** — competitor monitoring (pilot program): a weekly Telegram report on changes on competitors' public websites, their Meta ads and public reviews; from 199 PLN net/month.
- **KREATO Serwis** — field service management: job intake, crew scheduling, calendar, PDF protocols. Pilot program, see /serwis.html

## Pricing (Karolina AI, net prices in PLN; by default a receipt (rachunek) without VAT because the seller is not a VAT payer; on request an invoice with 23% VAT can be issued via the Useme platform; VAT will be added after VAT registration)
Annual contract (12 months), PLN net per month:
- Lite: 249 (300 min; works by forwarding calls from your own number, no separate +48 number)
- Starter: 349 (700 min; new +48 number included)
- Business: 449 (1000 min)
- Pro Max: 599 (1400 min)
Monthly billing (no annual contract), PLN net per month: Lite 279, Starter 379, Business 479, Pro Max 679.
- Minutes above the limit: Lite 0.89, Starter 0.79, Business 0.69, Pro Max 0.59 PLN net per minute.
- Trial: 7 days for 0 PLN, no card, up to 100 minutes of calls. Configuration normally 599 PLN net one-time (Lite: 299 PLN), 0 PLN for the first 10 companies in exchange for a review after 30 days and permission to name the company. After the trial the customer picks a package or cancels (the assistant then switches off, nothing is charged).
- Referral program: a customer who brings in a new customer (company) gets 20% of that company's monthly subscription as a discount on their own invoice for the first 12 months of the referred company's contract (discounts stack up to 100%; conditions on the FAQ, question 29a).
- Minute limits: each package has a monthly minute limit; at 80% the customer gets an e-mail recommending a top-up or a higher package; minutes above the limit are billed at the package rate.
- Annual plan extras: price locked for 12 months, configuration 0 PLN (instead of 599 PLN; Lite 299 PLN), up to 1 knowledge-base update per month included, payment monthly or upfront for 12 months, 30-day money-back guarantee on subscription fees (conditions in the Terms: https://kreato.tech/regulamin.html). Savings versus monthly billing: 360 PLN per year (Lite, Starter, Business), 960 PLN per year (Pro Max).
- Setup: about 10-20 minutes for an online form, bot ready in 2-3 business days.

## Annual plans and bundles (other products, PLN net per month)
- Annual plan = pay for 10 months, use 12; price locked for 12 months; monthly billing without commitment stays available. Chatbot AI 165 (1,990 per year), SMM + Reels AI 165 (1,990), Reklama FB/IG 207 (2,490, ad budget separate), Raporty automatyczne 124 (1,490). Monitoring and KREATO Serwis are pilots: the pilot price stays locked.
- Second bot in a bundle: Chatbot AI and SMM 159 instead of 199, Raporty 119 instead of 149, Reklama from 199 instead of 249 (monthly); in the annual plan 133 / 133 / 99 / 166. Example: Karolina Lite annual 249 + Chatbot AI annual bundle 133 = 382 per month instead of 478 monthly separately.

## Contact
- Phone: +48 459 567 844 (Karolina AI, live demo, available 24/7; calls may be recorded)
- Email: biuro@kreato.tech (an automatic confirmation arrives within 5 minutes; an AI assistant answers around the clock and hands complex cases to a human)
- Address: ul. Prądzyńskiego 23, 63-000 Środa Wielkopolska, Poland

## Compliance
- Karolina identifies herself as an AI assistant at the start of the call.
- Personal data is processed according to GDPR (RODO). Privacy Policy: https://kreato.tech/polityka-prywatnosci.html

## Technical
- Powered by LiveKit (voice AI), n8n (automation), Supabase
- Languages: Polish (primary), English on request
